children: Mohand Bouari has been appointed as the new governor of the Algerian Central Bank, local television Ennahar said on Thursday.
Bourai previously served as president of the Professional Association of Banks and CEO of the Bank of Agriculture.
He replaced Mohamed Lamine Lebbou, who was named Minister of Finance in a cabinet reshuffle announced by President Abdelmadjid Tebboune this week.
